line_zh: 一座可以走进去的 3D 柑橘港湾，日落、夜景、清晨会自己流转。
line_en: A 3D citrus harbor you can walk into, drifting from sunset to night to dawn on its own.
lead_zh: 用 Three.js 程序化搭建的港湾主题公园，约 220×150 米，分柑橘集市、植物温室、灯塔高地、僵尸船坞、梯田小镇五个区域。可以总览环绕，也可以用第一或第三人称步行、飞行；喷泉、温室、灯塔、吊机、罐头厂靠近都能互动，还有在线排行榜和港湾留言。
lead_en: A procedurally built harbor theme park in Three.js, about 220 × 150 m across five districts. Orbit the whole island, or walk and fly through it in first or third person. The fountain, greenhouse, lighthouse, crane and cannery all respond when you walk up, and there is a live leaderboard and guestbook.

line_zh: 一池可以触摸的水。划过水面泛起涟漪，靠近锦鲤会游过来，轻点一下投下鱼食。
line_en: A pond you can touch: ripples follow your cursor, koi swim over to you, and a tap drops food.
lead_zh: 涟漪来自实时的水面波动模拟，水底的光纹会跟着弯折；每条锦鲤都有自己的巡游、靠近、抢食和散开。没人操作的时候，水面也会偶尔自己泛起涟漪。
lead_en: Ripples come from a real-time wave simulation that bends the light on the pond floor. Each koi cruises, approaches, feeds and scatters on its own, and the water stirs now and then even when no one is touching it.

line_zh: 远看是一颗完整的小地球，拉近就进入城市和地貌的立体沙盘。
line_en: From afar it is a whole tiny planet; zoom in and you land in a 3D diorama of a city or landscape.
lead_zh: 18 座城市、12 类自然地貌，共 30 个沙盘。地球俯冲到目的地后，沙盘从平面隆起，楼宇生长、树木冒出；可以切换清晨、正午、黄昏、夜晚，开启环游世界自动导览，或把当前视角冲印成明信片。
lead_en: 30 dioramas: 18 cities and 12 kinds of landscape. Fly down to a place and the ground rises, buildings grow and trees sprout. Switch between dawn, noon, dusk and night, take an automatic world tour, or print the current view as a postcard.

line_zh: 移动鼠标，和戴着耳机的毛绒 Jolly 对上目光。也可以拉近看看，安静地陪伴一会儿。
line_en: Move your pointer to meet Jolly's gaze. Come closer to this headphone-wearing plush companion, or pause and stay a while.
lead_zh:
戴着耳机的奶油色毛绒伙伴，会随着鼠标或手指的移动轻轻转头。可以暂停跟随、回到正面，也可以拉近看看卷绒、五官和耳机。

由同一份 Blender 模型渲染出 95 个真实姿态，配合 1,146 张光流补间形成 1,241 张姿态图。首页用 Canvas 2D 播放；“关于 Jolly”里还可以打开 Three.js 三维探索。
lead_en:
A cream-colored plush companion in headphones gently turns its head toward your pointer or touch. Pause its gaze, return to the front, or come closer to see the fleece, face and headphones.

The same Blender model provides 95 native renders, joined by 1,146 optical-flow intermediates for 1,241 pose frames. The main experience uses Canvas 2D; a separate Three.js exploration mode is available through About Jolly.

title_zh: SUGAR 粒子 · 黑底荧光
line_zh: 荧光粒子聚成 SUGAR。移过鼠标，拨动光点，移开后慢慢归位。
line_en: Lime particles gather into SUGAR. Move your pointer to stir the dots, then let them spring back.
lead_zh:
全屏黑底上，黄绿色粒子从散布状态收敛为 SUGAR。鼠标经过字母时，附近的粒子会被推开，并随移动方向产生轻微拖曳；移开鼠标或松开手指后，光点弹性归位。

点击“进入”，粒子向外散开，露出同页首页，地址不变。支持手机触屏，可直接在浏览器体验。
lead_en:
Yellow-green particles on a black canvas gather into SUGAR. Moving across the letters pushes nearby dots aside with a little directional drag. Move away or lift your finger and the dots spring home.

Choose Enter to scatter the particles and reveal the homepage without changing the URL. Mouse and touch input are supported.

title_zh: SUGAR 粒子 · 白底黑点
line_zh: 白色画布上的黑色粒子，随鼠标散开、牵动，再弹回 SUGAR。
line_en: Black particles on a white canvas scatter and follow your pointer, then spring back into SUGAR.
lead_zh:
白色画布上，大小不一的黑色粒子从散布状态收敛为 SUGAR。鼠标经过字母时，附近的粒子会被推开，并随移动方向产生轻微拖曳；移开鼠标或松开手指后，光点弹性归位。

点击“进入”，粒子向外散开，露出同页首页，地址不变。支持手机触屏，可直接在浏览器体验。
lead_en:
Black particles of different sizes gather into SUGAR on a white canvas. Moving across the letters pushes nearby dots aside with a little directional drag. Move away or lift your finger and the dots spring home.

Choose Enter to scatter the particles and reveal the homepage without changing the URL. Mouse and touch input are supported.

line_zh: U 盘自动向前，对准接口，再翻个面。插对继续加速，插错就得重来。
line_en: Keep the USB moving: line up with the port and flip it the right way. Plug in to speed up; miss and start again.
lead_zh:
一个斜上方桌面视角的 3D 小游戏。U 盘持续向前，电脑从上方落下；用方向键、A/D 或手指滑动，在三个接口位置之间移动，再用空格或翻转按钮切换正反面。

插对后电脑散架，下一段速度提高 5%；插错则本局结束。昵称会保存在本机，结束后自动保存成绩。可以查看全国排行榜与全部挑战历史，桌面侧栏和手机弹窗都提供操作演示。
lead_en:
A 3D runner viewed from above the desk. The USB moves forward while computers drop into its path. Use arrow keys, A/D or a swipe to line up with one of three port positions, then press Space or tap Flip to turn it over.

A correct insertion breaks the computer apart and raises the next speed by 5%. A miss ends the run. Your nickname stays on the device, and scores save automatically. Browse the shared leaderboard and attempt history, with a tutorial available on desktop and mobile.

line_zh: 把旅行收进纸质文件夹，翻看城市与地点，再用照片、贴纸和手绘拼出一页回忆。
line_en: Collect trips in paper folders, browse places, and build a page of memories with photos, stickers and drawing.
lead_zh:
以纸质文件夹为灵感的旅行手账，内置巴黎、马尔代夫、巴塞罗那、巴厘岛、东京和迪拜六组示例旅行。可以搜索相册、查看地点笔记，也可以从时间线回看行程。

拼贴编辑器支持拖动素材、添加贴纸、编辑文字、导入本机照片和自由涂画，并可播放拼贴幻灯片。整个网页由一个 HTML 文件组成，无需安装或构建；编辑内容只保留在当前浏览器会话中，刷新后会重置。
lead_en:
A travel journal inspired by paper folders, with six sample trips: Paris, the Maldives, Barcelona, Bali, Tokyo and Dubai. Search albums, explore place notes or revisit trips on the timeline.

The collage editor supports dragging items, stickers, editable text, local photo import and freehand drawing, plus a collage slideshow. Everything runs from one HTML file with no installation or build step. Edits last only for the current browser session and reset after a reload.
